title: Kit Green ran the CIA's 'weird desk'

tellings.quote: He ran the CIA's quote unquote weird desk for a long period of time.

plain: A man named Kit Green ran what Michels calls, in quotation marks, the CIA's "weird desk" for a long time, a post handling unusual subjects. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, while talking about a ranch tied to strange events whose owner he interviews.
